title: Degree condition forcing a $K_{2,m}$ subgraph
statement:
Let $G$ be a finite simple graph with vertex set $V$, write $n = \abs{V}$ for its number of vertices and $d(v)$ for the degree of a vertex $v$, and let $m \ge 2$ be an integer. If
\[ (m-1)\binom{n}{2} < \sum_{v \in V} \binom{d(v)}{2}, \]
then $G$ contains a copy of the complete bipartite graph $K_{2,m}$.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a finite simple graph on vertex set $V$
replaced:
\emph{.  }If \texttt{G} is simple and
\texttt{$\sum$\_\{v $\in$ V\} C(d(v), 2) > (m-1)C($\nu$, 2)}, then \texttt{G} contains \texttt{K\_\{2,m\}} (\texttt{m $\ge$ 2}).*

\textbf{7.3.4}  $(a)^*$  Show that if $G$ is simple and
$\displaystyle\sum_{v \in V} \binom{d(v)}{2} > (m-1)\binom{\nu}{2}$, then $G$
contains $K_{2,m}(m \ge 2)$.
